title: Center Of It All Estate | KEY.co
description_expanded: Diverse sleeping arrangements span across three levels, with eight spacious bedrooms. The grandeur continues with a King suite complete with a luxurious ensuite bath featuring a soaking tub. Another highlight is the large King suite with its exterior entrance, offering a unique blend of privacy and access. And for those who ascend to the third level, a delightful array of rooms awaits, alongside gaming entertainment. But the indoors is just the beginning. Outdoors, the heated pool invites for sun-soaked days, complemented by the resort-style lounge. Come evening, the stone courtyard patio becomes an ideal gathering spot, with its upscale seating around a gas fire pit. And for those with a competitive spirit, the upcoming pickleball court beckons for friendly family tournaments. Set on over an acre of landscaped grounds, this estate offers endless opportunities for fun and relaxation. From soccer games in the vast yard to basketball matches in the driveway, every moment promises joy and togetherness. Not to forget, its prime location in the Centerville Historic District is a gateway to the best of Cape Cod, with a beach pass at the ready for those beach day excursions. Truly, this home isn’t just a vacation rental; it’s an experience, an unforgettable sojourn into luxury and leisure.
